title: Knowledge and Automation Plane authority and lifecycle
objective: Define the authoritative sources, documentary lifecycle, read-only evidence flow, and generic graph-port/X6-adapter boundary for the Architecture Studio before further implementation.
validations: repository owner explicitly confirmed ADR-0012 on 2026-07-29
control-plane audit passed with zero model calls and zero side effects
Graph IR generation and freshness check passed with 23 nodes and 18 edges
TypeScript checks passed for x6-canvas, graph-x6, and architecture-studio
manual authority, lifecycle, dependency-direction, and zero-duplication review passed
risks: Defining framework-specific hooks before a real framework consumer would create a false abstraction.
Moving or renaming graph-x6 in the ADR task would mix planning with an unreviewed package migration.
A viewer that edits derived evidence directly would violate the Knowledge Plane authority model.
